name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.5 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 30 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2026-04-06, at wavelengths from 1.08 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
